text:
miya: spotted mismatch between metered tokens and ledger totals for window 2026-07-09T01:10Z-01:40Z. about 72 customers have under-reported usage on interim invoices. looks like a commit-flush race in the ledger writer. tagging owners for remediation + customer plan.
eden: quick triage: the metering stream emitted correct events but ledger-writer failed to commit the last flush; retries then produced duplicate compensating entries in another partition causing net-loss when reconciler deduped by timestamp. root cause: non-atomic flush + partitioned-commit race.
rahman: I can craft a repair that replays missing commits and computes net-deltas. ETA dry-run 4h. will run in dry-run and post /artifacts.
billing-bot: FIN-5407 created: "Ledger flush race -> undercounted interim invoices" (owners: rahman, miya, eden). Priority: P1. Linked to INC-2026-0709.
ops-gke: containment: put throttles on ledger-writer flush concurrency at 01:22Z and disabled auto-retry-on-conflict. added alert for `ledger.flush_failures > 0` paging on SLO breach.
miya: proposed actions: 1) Stabilize ledger writer (owner: eden) due: 2026-07-09T18:00Z. 2) Run repair replay dry-run (owner: rahman) due: 2026-07-09T06:00Z. 3) Produce reconciliation CSV for finance (owner: miya) due: 2026-07-09T08:00Z. 4) Provisional credits for affected customers (owner: miya) due: 2026-07-09T12:00Z. 5) Final invoice adjustments after repair (owner: billing ops) due: 2026-07-10T16:00Z. 6) Postmortem + recurrence mitigation (owner: eden) due: 2026-07-15. please ack or reassign.
eden: ack. plan: make ledger flush idempotent via flush_id + durable marker, add unit+integration test, canary in us-east-1 at 2026-07-09T20:00Z.
rahman: dry-run command: ```./ledger_replay --start 2026-07-09T01:10Z --end 2026-07-09T01:40Z --dry-run --out dryrun-0709.log``` staging dry-run: 70 affected cust_ids. will upload CSV to FIN-5407 artifacts.
miya: finance note: CSV should include (customer_id, invoice_id, orig_tokens, recovered_tokens, net_delta, provisional_credit_cents). we'll hold final invoice corrections until repair completes. provisional credit policy: apply credits for net_delta > 0 automatically.
qa-metering: please add regression that simulates concurrent flush + partition fail and verify idempotency. tagging qa-metering.
ops-gke: monitoring follow-ups: new metric `ledger.flush_latency` and alert `flush_concurrency > 1 && flush_failures > 0` -> page. added dashboard tile.
rahman: uploaded dry-run CSV: /artifacts/fin5407/dryrun.csv. rahman -> miya: can you confirm format?
miya: confirmed, will compute credits and draft customer comms after crosscheck.
eden: I'll own postmortem and recurrence checklist. updating FIN-5407 as tasks progress. thanks all :white_check_mark:
